The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on higher education
se: Meeting on Monday 23 November 2026 at 10.30 hrs, Meeting Room 301, floor 3, Parliament House, and online. The agenda is to study “The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on higher education”, with representatives of the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, the National Science and Technology Development Agency (NSTDA) and a higher education institution invited to take part, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.

te: Draft report on the integrated agricultural system, a beef cattle complaint from Si Sa Ket, and a proposal to postpone a study visit
